correctness.instructions: Does the centralized artifact gate, migration 010, or updated MCP/REST/pack/registry paths mis-enforce visibility, break the public corpus, or leave a retrieval path ungated?

security.instructions: Can a forged ID, guessed URI, cross-workspace save, search facet, pack export, or cache/preview path leak private or workspace-restricted artifact metadata or bytes? Any oracle distinguishing missing from denied? Any secret material?

compatibility.instructions: Does the migration, new columns, changed REST/MCP signatures, or tightened saveReference break existing canonical contracts beyond the intended gated-read change?

evidence.instructions: Are the 7 DB gate tests plus MCP/REST cross-workspace negatives sufficient for owner/member/outsider, public/global-registry, laundering, search scoping, and byte gating?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterministic scoping, transaction hazard in saveReference/exportReferencePack, or SQL placeholder/type failure across PGlite and PostgreSQL?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond actor-scoped reads: new endpoints, donor imports, provider changes, billing, or unrelated refactors?
